source_discovery: The official SKU 910465 page names the product Balance Test Basic Kit and displays /productimages/large/910465.png. Its own click-to-enlarge handler removes the /large/ path segment and loads /productimages/910465.png, the downloaded 650 x 650 original.
visual_verification: The image shows a Zinzino BalanceTest box and regular Zinzino BalanceOil+ Orange Lemon Mint bottle. No Premium Edition marking is present.
alteration: None. The source PNG was downloaded byte-for-byte and was not redrawn, regenerated, upscaled, converted, or otherwise modified.
uncertainty_or_caveat: The official page exposed one SKU-specific product photograph and no alternate views. The 650 x 650 enlargement is the highest-resolution asset requested by the page; the page and its Open Graph metadata use a 560 x 560 /large/ derivative.
